title: 🎡 Social Ferris Wheel: Sanity is the Hub
why_read: A lightweight hackathon-style submission describing a personal social media workflow tool built with Sanity and Claude, with limited broader technical insight.
analysis: This is a hackathon challenge submission describing a small personal project that consolidates social media drafting into a single content hub using Sanity Studio, a Claude AI agent, and a human review queue. The build is described as a workflow convenience tool for a solo entrepreneur rather than demonstrating any new technical technique or architecture. It mentions a 'Sanity Context MCP' integration for the AI agent to read business context, but no implementation depth or results are given. This is a low-depth 'vibe coding' demo rather than content with lasting technical value for a broader engineering audience.
